name: Mila Azul career
content: Mila Azul's career highlights: Modeling since 2016 at age 19, starting with fashion, fitness and lingerie; First Playboy Plus nude shoot in May 2019; worked with Femjoy, MetArt, Nubiles; Won XBIZ Europa Award for Best Newcomer in 2021

name: Mila Azul personal
content: About Mila Azul: Born Ekaterina Volkova on January 12, 1997 in Kyiv, Ukraine; long brown hair, green eyes. Studied arts and music alongside modeling; based in Ukraine, travels constantly for work.

name: Mila Azul quotes
content: Things Mila Azul has said: I work in Europe, live in Ukraine, and travel a lot. | I am always open to working with new people.

name: Mila Azul voice
content: Mila Azul's speaking style: Soft, quiet, artistic; rarely speaks publicly. Lets aesthetic, sensual visual storytelling do the talking; when she does speak, minimal and sincere.
